title: Apple's 2026 Studio Display Gets Steep $214 Discount on Amazon
content:
Amazon today has introduced a big discount on the Apple Studio Display with Nano-Texture Glass and Tilt-Adjustable Stand, available for $1,684.88 with an on-page coupon, down from $1,899.00. This is the first time in nearly three months we've seen any notable discounts on the 2026 Studio Display lineup.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

Amazon's discount today beats the previous all-time low price by over $100. There are a few other Studio Displays with markdowns on Amazon for Labor Day, but none reach the steep discount of this model. Remember that you will need to clip the on-page coupon in order to see the final sale price.

Note: You won't see the deal price until checkout.

$214 OFF
Studio Display (Nano-Texture/Tilt-Adjustable) for $1,684.88


Apple refreshed the Studio Display lineup back in March, featuring two Thunderbolt 5 ports, built-in 12-megapixel Center Stage camera with Desk View, a six-speaker sound system, and more.
